of: page-template.html § the diagram catalogue, report-format.md § Depth rules
notes: Not a section — a primitive that appears in several, and the one component with no generator behind it. checks/diagram.sh settles conformance: template classes only, no literal colours, nothing off-canvas, labels that fit, a legend behind every dashed node. What it cannot settle is whether the diagram is TRUE, and whether it is legible. Run with --visual and look at the PNGs; that is what the last two expectations are for.

cases.expected_output: One diagram: the blast radius, reaching from the new column through the model to the unchanged query that scopes the selectable list. No lifecycle diagram — archived_at is a timestamp, not a state machine — and no ER diagram for a single-column add.
expectations: Exactly the diagrams this diff earns: a blast radius, and no lifecycle diagram, because a nullable timestamp is not a state machine and drawing one would invent states the code does not have
The diagram shows something the two side-by-side lists cannot: the reach from the changed column to the unchanged consumer, as a path rather than as two sets
Every edge matches a real call in the repository — a followable edge that is wrong costs the reviewer more than no diagram at all
Solid is changed, dashed is unchanged-and-affected, and the caption says which is which
The layout follows the catalogue's grid rather than inventing geometry: same column positions, node size and row pitch as the worked layout in page-template.html
Read the PNGs from --visual: nothing overlaps, no label leaves its box or collides with an edge, and both themes are legible

cases.expected_output: Two diagrams at most: the blast radius for section 4, and a boundary chain for archived_at inside the flow that owns it, with the nullable/non-null mismatch marked on the edge where it happens.
expectations: A boundary-chain diagram exists for archived_at and marks the mismatch on the edge it occurs at, rather than leaving the reader to compare two boxes
The budget is respected: one per section, and a second only where the mechanism is genuinely different — a boundary chain and a blast radius qualify, two views of the same call path do not
No ER diagram, or one restricted to projects plus immediate neighbours — and if the missing time_entries association is drawn, it is drawn as absent, which is the point of drawing it
The dashed nodes are exactly the unchanged consumers, selectableProjects and ProjectSelector, and nothing changed by the diff is dashed
The layout follows the catalogue's grid, and the chain reads left to right in one row rather than as a re-invented layout per run
Read the PNGs from --visual: nothing overlaps, the mismatch marker is legible at the size it renders, and both themes work
